title: Smart Taskbar
hint: Click to expand or collapse • Wheel to navigate • Right click for settings
disconnected: Waiting for compositor windows. Check the compositor requirements and diagnostic logging if the taskbar stays hidden.
action_failed: The compositor could not complete the window action.
unsupported_action: This compositor does not support the requested action.
launcher_missing: Install gtk-launch to start pinned desktop entries.

expand_mode.label: Expansion
expand_mode.description: Hover to reveal running apps, click to toggle, or keep the dock expanded.

hover_delay.label: Expand delay (ms)
hover_delay.description: Wait before opening the application strip on hover.

collapse_delay.label: Collapse delay (ms)
collapse_delay.description: Wait after the pointer leaves. Manual sorting stays open until clicked to protect drags.

animations.label: Animate transitions
animations.description: Smooth expansion fades and optional icon enlargement. Turn off for reduced motion.

animation_duration.label: Animation duration (ms)
animation_duration.description: Duration of short fades and hover enlargement; no idle frame loop.

min_width.label: Minimum width (px)
min_width.description: Manual mode. Minimum expanded extent in logical pixels, limited by maximum width.

max_width.label: Maximum width (px)
max_width.description: Main-axis limit, including padding and arrows. Use bar/widget scale 1 and host capsule padding 0 for the same outer limit.

collapsed_width.label: Collapsed width (px)
collapsed_width.description: Manual mode. Fixed collapsed extent in logical pixels. Hidden completely when no matching windows are open.

icon_size.label: Icon size (px)
icon_size.description: Manual mode. Base size in logical pixels. Leave room for hover enlargement within your bar thickness.

icon_spacing.label: Icon spacing (px)
icon_spacing.description: Manual mode. Gap between application cells. Single-window apps have no count lane or marker.

overflow_behavior.label: Overflow navigation
overflow_behavior.description: Wheel navigation replaces visible items; the viewport is clipped.

scroll_step.label: Scroll step
scroll_step.description: Application items per wheel gesture in item mode.

auto_reveal_focused.label: Reveal focused app
auto_reveal_focused.description: Reveal on focus changes and expansion. Manual wheel navigation remains usable until focus changes.

show_scroll_indicators.label: Overflow arrows
show_scroll_indicators.description: Subtle direction indicators inside the width budget.

display_mode.label: Application display
display_mode.description: Additional workspace and output filters below apply to running windows.

workspace_filter.label: Workspace filter
workspace_filter.description: Active uses compositor active or focused workspaces; combines with output filtering.

output_filter.label: Output filter
output_filter.description: Current means this bar instance’s output, not the globally focused monitor.

show_minimized.label: Include minimized
show_minimized.description: Umbriel reports minimized state; unavailable state is treated as not minimized.

grouping.label: Grouping
grouping.description: Unknown application IDs remain separate. Workspace groups use a representative application icon.

duplicate_indicator.label: Window count badges
duplicate_indicator.description: Numeric corner badges appear only for applications with more than one window.

sorting.label: Sorting
sorting.description: Launch order means first observed order. Manual order is per instance and resets on reload.

exclusions.label: Excluded apps
exclusions.description: Exact normalized desktop/application IDs. No shell patterns.

pinned_apps.label: Pinned applications
pinned_apps.description: Exact desktop-entry IDs for launchers. Launchers appear with matching open windows; the entire widget hides when no matching windows remain.

app_aliases.label: Application aliases
app_aliases.description: Map normalized unusual application IDs to desktop-entry IDs. Matching ignores case and a .desktop suffix.

collapsed_label.label: Collapsed text
collapsed_label.description: Optional text within the fixed width. Single-window apps never show a count; side bars show the icon only.

capsule_radius.label: Capsule radius
capsule_radius.description: Manual mode. Logical pixels for the plugin’s own theme-colored capsule.

opacity.label: Capsule opacity
opacity.description: Background alpha only; icons and text stay opaque.

border.label: Capsule border
border.description: Use the active theme outline role.

active_indicator.label: Highlight focused app
active_indicator.description: Use the theme primary container role.

minimized_indicator.label: Dim minimized apps
minimized_indicator.description: Dim a group only when every member is minimized.

urgent_indicator.label: Urgency border
urgent_indicator.description: Use the theme error role when compositor events provide urgency. Umbriel does not guarantee this field.

badge_placement.label: Count position
badge_placement.description: Place overlay counts on the upper left or right; inline counts before or after the icon. Side bars keep inline counts below the icon.

click_behavior.label: Left click
click_behavior.description: Grouped apps always cycle windows. Minimize requires compositor support.

middle_click.label: Middle click
middle_click.description: Host defaults to widget settings. To use these actions, explicitly set this instance’s actions.middle = "none".

refresh_fallback.label: Subscription retry (s)
refresh_fallback.description: Seconds between failed startup retries. Connected streams are event-driven; disconnected streams use their own bounded reconnect delay.

diagnostic_logging.label: Diagnostic logging
diagnostic_logging.description: Log subscription and action errors. Window titles are not logged.

compositor_compatibility.label: Compositor compatibility
compositor_compatibility.description: Automatic supports Umbriel, niri, Hyprland, Mango, and Sway. A selected compositor restricts this widget to that session.

hover_enlarge.label: Enlarge icons on hover
hover_enlarge.description: Magnify the hovered application inside a fixed cell. No bar movement; respects reduced motion.

hover_scale.label: Hover enlargement
hover_scale.description: Maximum icon scale. Set bar thickness to at least icon size × scale + 8 logical pixels; 1.15 fits a 22 px icon in a 34 px bar.

badge_style.label: Count layout
badge_style.description: Overlay a compact count on the icon, or place it beside the icon inside the app capsule. Side bars place inline counts below the icon. Only duplicate windows show a count.

inline_count_style.label: Inline count appearance
inline_count_style.description: Choose a plain number on the shared app capsule or a separate number bubble within it. Applies only to inline counts; overlay badges keep their bubble.

sizing_mode.label: Sizing
sizing_mode.description: Auto fits icons, spacing, capsule radius and collapsed size to bar configuration, and hides those manual controls. Manual restores your saved dimensions. Maximum width remains available in both modes.

sizing_bar.label: Sizing bar name
sizing_bar.description: Leave empty to fit matching bars conservatively, or enter a configured bar name such as default. Used only in Automatic mode. If no matching placement is found, manual dimensions are used.

dependency_missing: Cannot start the application taskbar: {dependency} is unavailable.
